name: ont-068-fixture-ledger
description: e2e fixture repo for ONT-068: the three BigInt shapes a stock Laravel or Rails schema produces (a BIGINT key, a BIGINT UNSIGNED key, and an INT key carrying a BIGINT foreign key), plus a BigInt-free control whose emitted bytes must not move. Copied OUT OF REPO so the Prisma-major probe reads the node_modules the scenario plants rather than the monorepo's own.
